question: The amount on a sum of ₹7,300 at 10% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the successive percentage formula, the effective compound interest rate for 2 years at 10% per annum is:

Effective CI rate = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10) ÷ 100 = 21%

The total amount becomes 100% (Principal) + 21% (Interest) = 121% of the principal.

Amount = 121% of ₹7,300 = (121 ÷ 100) × 7300

Amount = 121 × 73 = ₹8,833

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8,833.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹7,300

Rate of Interest (R) = 10% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount (A) = P(1 + R / 100)T
